data.description: By the time we get to level 5 there are way too many power ups being dropped as the player is overpowered and destroying everything instantly. We need to increase the number of enemies proportional to the level and descrease the power-up drops.
data.title: As the levels progress increase the number of enemies and decrease the number of power ups
